answer: Reaching eligibility takes 69 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time anyone forfeits for every seat it wants. The vertex register is checked at draw time, echo lists the eligible set, and copper seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 69 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh army of identities has no way to grade its own output. The deposit is 80 dollars a seat. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
